target: v2.0 residual state freedom after fixed scalar-amplitude quotient
executive_verdict: P1 fixes the geometry, horizon temperature, coexact spectrum, and rank-one Hawking quotient, but does not reduce the full h_vec state space to finite freedom. An infinite-dimensional residual covariance cone remains outside the current scalar-amplitude readout.

main_theorem.name: Infinite Residual State Freedom after Fixed Scalar-Amplitude Quotient
main_theorem.scope: relative to the current scalar-amplitude observable family
main_theorem.statement: After imposing P1, P2, the Paper 27 Spatial CCR Lift, and the Paper 31 rank-one scalar-amplitude quotient selection, the admissible full-carrier covariance space contains an infinite-dimensional residual cone R_A of covariance perturbations satisfying B DeltaG B^dagger = 0.
